crossRefs.note: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

parallels.note: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

translations.web: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
translations.bsb: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.
translations.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
translations.asv: For by thee I run upon a troop; By my God do I leap over a wall.
